# testing_oas_minlength (Resource)

OASMinlength Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_minlength" "my_oasminlength" {
  oneof_request              = "...my_oneof_request..."
  oneof_request_and_response = "...my_oneof_request_and_response..."
  oneof_response             = "...my_oneof_response..."
  request                    = "...my_request..."
  request_and_response       = "...my_request_and_response..."
  response                   = "...my_response..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `oneof_request` (String) oneOf request only minLengths (union of 1 and 2)
- `oneof_request_and_response` (String) oneOf request and response minLengths (union of 1 and 2)
- `oneof_response` (String) oneOf response only minLengths (union of 1 and 2)
- `request` (String) request only minLength (1)
- `request_and_response` (String) request and response minLength (both 12)
- `response` (String) response only minLength (2)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_minlength.my_testing_oas_minlength
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_minlength.my_testing_oas_minlength "..."
```
